notes: SPOTLIGHT SOLO v2 RIVAL FRONT (the wall of defenders, front view toward the lens, full body; Rivals project, RIVAL_KIT letters). Frames 1-4 (RF1-RF4) are the standard body, drawn in kit A; B and C are tone-for-tone hex swaps in code (B = RIVAL_KIT_B: s #b06e4a u #74422c v #463c3c w #282022 x #120c0e; C = RIVAL_KIT_C: s #8c5c40 u #5c3a28 v #342c30 w #1c161a x #0c080a; source hex: s #e8ac84 u #aa6e56 v #c89646 w #96622c x #5a361e). Frames 5-8 (RF1T-RF4T) are the same four poses drawn on THE TOWER's body (defender D, MERIDIAN v2's TowerIdle model: ~1.3x bulk at the same 98 px height, buzz cut, heavy brow, square jaw, the captain's armband on his LEFT upper arm = screen-right, black gloves; RIVAL_KIT, no swap). Front view, never mirrored (no west strip). Registration = Stand Front: body centre x 64, soles on row 102. contact = the outer row-102 sole pixel of the planted boot (RF1/RF3/RF1T/RF3T: the screen-left boot; RF2/RF4/RF2T/RF4T: the left-most pixel of the planted screen-right boot, the other foot lifted or stepped back); contactL / contactR / soleL / soleR = the row-102 sole runs when both boots are down (soleRun / plantSole when one is). head = skull centre, chest = sternum, eyeL / eyeR (eyesCovered on RF4/RF4T: the forearm / glove across them); fistL / fistR, gloveL / gloveR (the Tower), knee / bootSole / stud1-3 (RF2 raised boot), elbow / wrist / fist / glove / hand (the blinded fend), mouth, chin. Points are pixel indices (studioAnim adds 0.5; contact lands on the bottom edge of row 102). Shot 2a: RF3 0.00 (STOMP 1, in unison), RF1 0.25-0.65 (1 px code breath), RF2 0.65 (and the cut-in frame), RF3 0.80 (STOMP 2), RF1 1.10-1.60; 2c: RF4 2.40-2.80 (lit hard white). D uses the T frames in 2a / 2c. Studio: Rivals / RivalFront / Front, layer Art (Side/Back blank).
